title: Publication-manifest namespace and validation-contract failure
objective: Repair the upstream repository governance and validation defects. Reduced GitHub notification volume is a consequence, not the objective.

scope: Introduce an explicit publication-state document schema
Grandfather unchanged canonical legacy manifests until their next edit
Fail closed for new or changed schema-less or unsupported records
Migrate the three incompatible records without changing their substantive publication boundaries
Preserve direct Pages readback as pending where it was pending
prohibited_scope: No substantive merits, evidence or public-narrative changes
No validator bypass, skipped file or weakened publication-state threshold
No branch-protection change until the repaired aggregate source gate is proven green

root_cause.direct: The governed publication-manifests directory contained heterogeneous JSON records, while the wrapper implicitly delegated every non-transition record to the legacy publication-state validator.
systemic: No explicit document-type discriminator for new or changed records
The failing publication-integrity check was not required before merge
Successful focused validation and Pages deployment could coexist with a failed global integrity gate

closure_criteria: The explicit-schema classifier and checked-in contract pass on the repair branch
All three migrated records pass the legacy publication-state thresholds without overstating live verification
The publication-integrity check is green on the pull-request head
The repair is merged at an exact SHA and publication-integrity is green on the resulting main
A separate enforcement change makes the stable aggregate integrity check mandatory before future merges

continuity.notification_correlation_rule: Group workflow notifications by repository, head SHA and normalized first-failure fingerprint; do not create one branch per email.
